filters.first_sync: 7 days (user, 2026-10-21); later syncs from 3 days before the last sync
filters.undated: first read of a page: its undated PDFs count as already there (unless the URL names this or last month: then dated by the PDF's creation date); later: a new undated PDF is dated the day it first appeared, skipped when the PDF was created over 30 days before
